#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdint>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

long long pow_mod(long long a, long long n, long long mod) {
    long long ret = 1;
    int x = 63 - __builtin_clzll(n);
    for (; x >= 0; x--) {
        ret = ret * ret % mod;
        if (n & (1LL << x))
            ret = ret * a % mod;
    }
    return ret;
}

long long C(int n, int r, const vector<vector<long long>>& fif) {
    if (n < 0 || r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
    return fif[0][n] * fif[1][r] % MOD * fif[1][n - r] % MOD;
}

vector<vector<long long>> enumFIF(int n, int mod) {
    vector<long long> f(n + 1), invf(n + 1);
    f[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        f[i] = f[i - 1] * i % mod;
    }
    long long a = f[n];
    long long b = mod;
    long long p = 1, q = 0;
    while (b > 0) {
        long long c = a / b;
        long long d;
        d = a;
        a = b;
        b = d % b;
        d = p;
        p = q;
        q = d - c * q;
    }
    invf[n] = (p < 0) ? p + mod : p;
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        invf[i] = invf[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod;
    }
    return {f, invf};
}

void solve() {
    int n;
    long long K;
    cin >> n >> K;
    if (K >= n) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return;
    }

    auto fif = enumFIF(250000, MOD);
    if (K == 0) {
        cout << fif[0][n] << endl;
        return;
    }

    long long ans = 0;
    int sign = 1;
    for (int i = n - K; i >= 1; i--) {
        long long term = C(n, i, fif) * pow_mod(i, n, MOD) % MOD * sign % MOD * C(n - i, K, fif) % MOD;
        ans = (ans + term) % MOD;
        sign = MOD - sign;
    }
    ans = ans * 2 % MOD;
    cout << ans << endl;
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
